# TV news — Style Prompt

> A television newsroom's on-air package built from a few repeated parts: a sting where a channel plate slams in and then becomes the corner bug, a rundown of today's stories that opens and closes the bulletin, a paper lower-third strap with a coloured category tab that never leaves the bottom, and full-frame graphics (split-flap number boards, stamps, source cards) that each state one fact. Ink ground, one signal colour, paper, a reserved alarm orange. 16:9, a clean frame: no crawl, no burned-in subtitles.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

1. **One package system, used consistently.** Every graphic is built from the same parts: a parallelogram plate, a coloured tab, a paper strap, ink cards with a signal-colour top edge, mono datelines, stamps. Viewers read the system before the words.
2. **The bulletin's order.** Sting, rundown ("three stories today"), item, item, back to the rundown ticked off, sign-off. Each item opens with its category on the strap's tab and its date on the first graphic.
3. **One fact per screen.** A full-frame graphic states one thing: the number, the change, the place, the quote, the verdict.
4. **The strap holds the headline.** Category tab above, headline 40 px, one smaller line below; its words change with a vertical flip, and the picture above it is free for the graphic.
5. **Footage-based.** The picture layer is the user's footage. The example paints one stand-in shot (a river at dusk) only so the strap has something to sit on; **the user's footage from `list_media` replaces it**, graded the same way (see section 2). Never fill the gap with generated people or places.

Not **Caption News** (captions-first social video, huge slammed words; here type is small and orderly and the graphics lead). Not a data dashboard (one chart or board per beat). Not a stage talk (no centred title-and-bullets). Not a studio show: no virtual set, no anchor, no fly-throughs; the package is flat graphics over ink or footage.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Ground**: flat `--latar` (ink) with a radial lift of `--utama` at 16% (ellipse 60% × 70% at 68% / 35%), seven slanted light bands (rotated 24°, 40–160 px wide, `--utama` at 3–8%) drifting 140 px left over the scene, and a 48 px dot grid at 7% `--teks`. Drawn per scene, so the wipe carries them.
- **Plate**: 640 × 180 parallelogram (skewX -15.5°), gradient from `--utama` +18% white to `--utama` -16% black, a tinta bar 56 px and a gold (`--aksen`) bar 22 px at the left, name in condensed bold, a glint (white 65%, 110 px band) crossing once. The same object is the sting, the bug (scale 0.327, centre 1739, 86), and may be the end card.
- **Strap**: tab 48 px high at x 96, y 856; paper bar 1250 × 104 at y 904 with a 14 px signal-colour left edge, a hard 8 px offset shadow, an end block 120 px wide with a 6 px signal top edge and the channel initials. Source line mono 15 px, right-aligned at x 1824, y 944, at most 36 characters.
- **Picture grade** (applies to the user's footage and to any stand-in): desaturated, deep blacks, one cool-to-warm cast; a left-to-right ink gradient (82% to clear by 78% width) under the type, a 55% vignette. Footage scale at most 1.5×; the slow push over a shot is 1.0 → 1.07 in 3.4 s.
- **Stand-in shot** (painted once from a seeded PRNG): dusk sky gradient, treeline, roofs with a few lit windows, water with ripples, a gauge post, a buoy. Replace with footage; never animate it more than a push and a rising water line.
- **Board**: ink card, 8 px signal top edge, tiles 150 × 190 with a 4 px seam, split into halves; old top flap folds shut, new bottom flap opens. Stamps: filled alarm colour, double outline, -8°.
- No grain on graphics, no glow, no 3D set, no drop shadows beyond the strap's hard one and a soft card shadow.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the ink: scenes, strap end block lightness. `--latar-2` is the cards (rundown rows, board). `--teks` is type on ink and the strap's **paper** (the bar fills with `--teks`, and its words use `--latar`, so it inverts correctly on a pale brand).
- `--utama` is the signal colour: plate, tab, row number blocks, wipe band, bars, light bands. As words it goes through `--utama-di-latar` (the big date month, the rolling +x, the end-block initials, tick marks, the highlight frame).
- `--aksen` is the gold: the third wipe edge, the plate's second bar, dashed connectors (`--aksen-di-latar`), datelines over footage (mixed into `--emas`).
- **Fixed, not brand**: paper white (`--kertas`) and tinta ink for type over footage, the alarm orange `--darurat` (only for a siren, a break, LIVE, a stamp, never decoration; a bulletin without an alarm never shows it), and the picture's own palette.
- On a pale brand the scenes turn white and the ink world inverts; type over footage stays paper white on its darkened gradient.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul`: condensed bold (Oswald 700, 500). Date numerals 190 px, row numbers 72 px, plate 68 px with 0.03em tracking, tab 28 px with 0.08em tracking, picture headline 148 px at 164 px line height, board digits 150 px.
- `--font-isi`: Inter 800 for rundown headlines (40 px), strap headline (40 px), Inter 600 for the strap's second line (22 px) and tags.
- Mono for datelines, sources, captions, board labels: IBM Plex Mono 600, 15–22 px, caps, 0.08–0.16em tracking. Extra token `--font-kode`.
- Everything on one line each; never wrap a strap. Strap headline at most about 54 characters at 40 px, second line about 90.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Grid**: a beat every 0.5 s, cuts and wipes on beat or half-beat. A package action (flip, count, stamp, tick, strap change) every 0.5–1 s; no frame flat for more than 1 s; a strong action within 0.5 s of every cut.
- Sting: slashes 0.04 and 0.10 s, plate `back.out(2.2)` from scale 0 over 0.28 s with -7° rotation, shake `[14, -12, 9, -6, 0]` px over 0.28 s, impact ring 0.3 → 2.6× in 0.5 s, letters drop 150 px staggered 0.03 s over 0.22 s, glint 0.27 s, flight to the corner 0.33 s `power2.inOut`. A hit within 0.4 s, done by 1.5 s.
- Rows flip in with `rotationX -90 → 0`, `back.out(1.4)`, 0.45 s, 0.25 s apart; the highlight frame pops with `back.out(2)` in 0.3 s.
- Wipe: a 103 px band (signal 84, ink 5, gold 14) crossing in 0.4 s `power2.inOut`, the new scene revealed behind it; the incoming picture's entry animation starts under the band.
- Strap flip: old words up and out, new words up from below, 0.32 s `power2.inOut`, the tab flashing white once. Masked headline lines rise 110% in 0.45 s `power3.out`, 0.25 s apart.
- Flap tiles 0.13 s fold + 0.13 s open per tile, tiles 0.14 s apart. Rolling number 0.7 s `power2.out`. Stamp lands from 1.9× in 0.16 s `power3.in`. Ticks draw in 0.3 s, 0.2 s apart.
- Holds: rundown 2.5–4 s, a shot 3.4 s, a board 3.6 s, the ending still ≥ 2 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Slow push on the picture, 1.0 → 1.07 | attention settling on the scene | the footage under a strap |
| Vertical band wipe | a new story or programme part | every cut between items |
| Hard cut with a package action | a beat inside one story | between two graphics of one item |
| Strap flip | the story moves on, the frame does not | a second angle on the same shot |
| Plate flight to the corner | the opening becomes the frame | the first 1.5 s only |
| Static locked graphic | the fact to remember | boards, stamps, sign-off |

## 7. Native moves

1. **Sting becomes the bug**: the plate slams in, then flies to the top right and stays for the whole bulletin. *Fits content like:* a neighbourhood bulletin, a creator's weekly round-up, a school's morning announcements, a shop's price update.
2. **Strap tab = category**: the tab names the category and flashes white when it changes; no separate item title cards. *Fits content like:* a market reopening, a clinic opening, a class result, a launch.
3. **Rundown, then ticked off**: the same list opens and closes the bulletin; at the end each row gets its tick. *Fits content like:* a weekly digest, a changelog, a event programme, a team's updates.
4. **Strap that never leaves**: one strap group per shot; words flip, the strap stays until the recap. *Fits content like:* a field report, a product demo with captions, a talk with chapter lines.
5. **Split-flap before and after**: old and new value on one board, tile by tile. *Fits content like:* a river level, a price change, a queue length, a score, a follower count.
6. **Dated eyebrow**: every graphic's eyebrow carries place and date in mono caps. *Fits content like:* a series of events on different days, a trip diary, a launch timeline.
7. **One stamp per story**: the verdict lands from 1.9× with a double outline. *Fits content like:* "siren on", "open", "sold out", "fixed", "approved".

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Package left behind.** Draw strap, source line and tag per picture, inside the wipe's clip, so the band changes the headline with the picture; a strap drawn once on top lags.
- **Leftover layout.** Without a crawl or subtitles, keep content above y 840 and lay the page for that; never leave a dead band above the strap.
- **Masked type peeking in.** Start a masked headline fully below its mask and hide it until it moves.
- **Words stronger than the source.** Write what the source says: a gauge reading is not a flood, a request is not a ruling. Name the time of a reading.
- **A schematic posing as data.** Tag a drawn chart as skematik and label only what you know; set a close with a flip, never a rolling counter that shows values that never existed.
- **Alarm colour as decoration.** `--darurat` only for the siren, a break, a stamp.
- **Stand-in left in.** The painted shot is a placeholder; replace it with the user's footage and keep the grade and gradient.
- **Gold on paper** is too weak: use ink on the strap.

# TV news: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 3.0, long 4.2.

## hook

- en: sting: two slashes, the channel plate slams in, letters drop, then it flies to the corner as the bug; the rundown rows flip in on the beat
- id: sting: dua garis miring, pelat saluran menghantam, huruf jatuh, lalu terbang ke pojok jadi logo; baris rundown dibalik masuk sesuai ketukan

## problem

- en: a shot under a strap with category tab and source line; masked headline lines rise, the picture pushes in slowly, strap words flip once
- id: satu gambar di bawah strap: tab kategori, judul, dan sumber; baris judul naik dari topeng, gambar mendekat pelan, kata strap dibalik sekali

## fact

- en: one fact per screen on an ink card with an accent top edge; the strap changes its words with a vertical flip, the tab flashes white
- id: satu fakta per layar di kartu tinta bertepi aksen; kata strap berganti dengan flip vertikal, tab berkedip putih

## step

- en: numbered rundown-style rows flip in 0.25 s apart on the beat; the current row gets an accent frame that pops in
- id: baris bernomor ala rundown dibalik masuk berjarak 0,25 detik sesuai ketukan; baris yang sedang dibahas diberi bingkai aksen

## compare

- en: split-flap board: old and new value on the same tiles, each tile flipping from old to new, then the difference called out to the right
- id: papan flap: nilai lama dan baru di ubin yang sama, tiap ubin dibalik dari lama ke baru, lalu selisihnya disebut di kanan

## number

- en: split-flap digits flip one by one to the new figure, then a rolling +x callout beside a dashed connector and one stamp
- id: angka papan flap dibalik satu per satu ke nilai baru, lalu +x berputar di samping garis putus-putus, dan satu cap

## proof

- en: a quote or source card: ink panel, large accent mark first, lines push up 0.18 s apart, name and date in mono caps, one stamp
- id: kartu kutipan atau sumber: panel tinta, tanda kutip aksen besar dulu, baris naik berjarak 0,18 detik, nama dan tanggal huruf mono, satu cap

## offer

- en: the strap carries the offer in its headline while a paper card lands on the ink with a stamp; tab reads the category
- id: penawaran ada di judul strap, sementara kartu kertas mendarat di latar tinta dengan satu cap; tab menyebut kategorinya

## cta

- en: sign-off strap slides up with the contact while the rundown is ticked off row by row; held 2 s
- id: strap penutup naik membawa kontak sementara rundown dicentang baris demi baris; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the rundown returns and each row is ticked, a sign-off strap slides up, bug in the corner; held 2 s
- id: rundown kembali dan tiap baris dicentang, strap penutup naik, logo di pojok; diam 2 detik
